SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rag_query_feedback f INNER JOIN rag_query_log l ON l.id = f.query_log_id
GROUP BY f.rating

SELECT f.id AS feedbackId, f.query_log_id AS queryLogId, f.rating AS rating, f.created_by AS createdBy, f.comment AS comment, f.corrected_answer AS correctedAnswer, f.feedback_status AS feedbackStatus, f.priority AS priority, f.assignee AS assignee, f.review_result AS reviewResult, f.created_at AS feedbackCreatedAt, l.tenant_id AS tenantId, l.query_type AS queryType, l.status AS status, l.trace_id AS traceId, l.conversation_id AS conversationId, l.query_text AS queryText, l.retrieval_mode AS retrievalMode, l.hit_count AS hitCount, l.total_tokens AS totalTokens, l.latency_ms AS latencyMs, l.created_at AS queryCreatedAt FROM rag_query_feedback f INNER JOIN rag_query_log l ON l.id = f.query_log_id
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
